[*][h3]Beastiary
[/h3]
[list]
[*]A new option appears at Recruitment Center that displays all monsters you've run into.  As you expand your bestiary, you'll earn rewards (Epic Mode Only).
[/list]
[*][h3]New Missions[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Creature Cull: Defeat a random set of monsters
[*] Monster Hunt: Take out the powerful monster-boss.  Rewards a Treasure.
[*] Titans: Post-game mission sequence where you must defeat an extremely powerful Titan (a monster-boss with overpowered abilities).
[/list]

[*][h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dragon Armor:  Gain ability Summon Dragon
[*]Scorpion Staff: Gain ability Summon Scorpion
[*]Ring of Arachnids: Gain ability Summon Broodling
[*]Storm Shield: Absorb Lightning Damage
[*]Demon's Ring: Gain ability Acquire Strength
[*]Venon Blade: Gain ability Venomous Strike
[*]Poison Staff: Gain ability Poison
[*]Pyromancer's Mask: Gain Rage: Flames
[*]Arcane Cloak: Increase Magic upon Rage trigger
[/list]
[*] [h3]Steam Cloud[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now open a save file on Steam Cloud.
[*] Unfortunately, cannot transfer existing files to the cloud
[/list]
[*] [h3]Survival Mode Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Removed Party Upgrade missions.  Was never intended to be part of this game-mode. 
[*]  Missions levels will rise to 90% of the next story mission. So there will no longer be lingering easy-missions.
[*] As a result of these two changes the game mode should be more difficult, I'll reset the leaderboard closer to the release date. 
[/list]
[*] [h3]Color Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Terrain across the game is less saturated
[*] The UI is less saturated
[*] All characters' colors have been redone.  Colors are lighter and saturation is more consistent.
[*] Black colors on characters have moved closer to dark-blue, dark-green, or magenta.
[/list]
[*][h3]New Features and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Turn Panel Hover: Hovering over a character in the turn-panel with a mouse will show an effect over the corresponding unit 
[*] The UI Turn Panel now works properly with Pyromancer's Gem and Kings' Crown
[*] First few job-levels provide double the Job-Points (Upgrading jobs felt too slow early on)
[*] Improved Commander and Pyromancer Sprites
[*] New Mercenaries for hire.  Larger of variety of mercenaries to hire at the Recruitment center.
[*] Players can now trade special items (Treasures).  The treasures are divided into a handful of buckets.
[*] Rogue's "Strength and Magic" passive skill (Use the max between the two) now works during battle and not just before battle.  It will also work with Arcane Staff.
[*] Speed, Focus, Strength, Magic and other job-upgrades have more description
[*] Arrest Warrant Mission will show the next enemy to defeat as the character in the Mission List screen 
[/list]
[*][h3]Bug Fixes and AI Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Astromancer's lack of ability to use Meteor
[*] Disease Icon is removed when character no longer has disease
[*] No longer a slight delay in summoning units.  Sprites are loaded before battle
[*] Fixed issue where Curse was not always working as intended (some skills avoided the effect)
[*] Fixed Holy Cloak + incorrectly reducing wearer's speed
[*] Fixed Champions Crown + and Mystic Pendant + (weren't increasing stats)
[*] Rock Armor affects Teleport-Move and not just Move
[*] Reinforcements have names
[*] Removed final Blacksmith Rarity mission that would crash the game
[*] Fixed issue where Triple-cast was not indicated as needing to be unlocked for Sorcerer
[*] Fixed issue where cure was indicated as needing to be unlocked for Paladin
[*] Fixed crash that could occur with Archer and Plague
[*] Fixed Bug/Crash with Kings' Crown description
[*] Aligned characters on Load Game button
[*] Fixed price of Celestial Pendant +
[*] AI will cast less often when enemies are nearby
[*] AI Melee units with Range abilities will not behave as though he were a range unit
[*] AI will use Fireball more often
[*] AI will stop using Ice Shield on enemies and use it on allies
[*] AI with Deflect or Ice Shield are less likely to cower away from Ice Shards
[*] AI Mystic Knights are a little smarter and will not use Mystic Blade as often
[*] AI will avoid attacking bombs or earth pillars for little reason
[*] AI will choose better targets for [i]Summon Bandit[/i] and [i]Summon Lancer[/i]

[/list]
[*][h3]What's Next?[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Trailer
[*] Achievements overhaul
[*] Set a release date
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Roguelite-Mode Overhaul and New Items
notes.content:
[h1]Roguelite Mode Overhaul[/h1]

All enemies are on the battlefield at the start. There are no reinforcements, pickups, or rewards when taking out enemy units.

[i]Dev Comment: Most of the features from the former Roguelite mode are a staple in Epic Mode.  Now that the battles are standard 6v6, the game mode can be faster and focus more on strategy.
[/i] 

[h1] Epic Mode EXP Change[/h1]

Epic mode no longer allows users to "Upgrade Equipment", which was a way to buy character levels with earned gold. EXP earned is nearly doubled, but Gold earned after each battle is reduced.

[i]Dev Comment: This feature was confusing for newer players because of how unusual it is to see in an RPG.  It is an important feature for the more strategy-oriented game modes (Survival, Roguelite) and so it still exists within those modes.
[/i]

notes.title: Game Fully Renovated
notes.content:
Start a new game to play! 

[list]
[*][h2]What's New?[/h2]
   [list]
      [*][h3] Story is completely overhauled![/h3]
      [list]
        [*] 40 story missions (not including the many quests and challenges)
        [*] 12 Cities / Towns
      [/list]
      [*] [h3]New Dice Mini-Game[/h3]
         [list][*]Buy, equip, and roll special dice in this minigame to earn prizes[/list]
      [*] [h3]Pickups[/h3]
         [list][*]Many missions have special bonuses lying around that when picked up offer increased stats, a summoned ally, a special buff, or the immediate casting of a spell[/list]
      [*] [h3]Enemy-Kill Rewards[/h3]
          [list][*]On some missions, when an opponent is defeated your character gains a bonus for the remainder of the battle[/list]
      [*] [h3]Enemy Reinforcements[/h3]
         [list][*]Enemies (not just soldiers) can arrive on the battlefield late[/list] 
      [*] [h3]Enemy Bosses[/h3]
         [list]
         [*]Boss characters have significant HP boost and may also have a special ability.
         [*]Some have the ability to cast a spell at multiple locations.  Others have special rage abilities. 
         [*]Enemy units will trickle in while you battle 
         [/list]
       [*] [h3]More Mission Options[/h3]
         [list]
         [*][b]Mission board[/b] offers quests, story, and generic missions
         [*][b]History[/b] allow you to play battles from the lore as though your character was there
         [*][b]Party Bonus[/b] offers mission that grant party bonuses (Epic Mode Only)
         [*][b]Challenge[/b] offers a variety of special missions for fun (Epic Mode Only)
         [/list]
       [*] [h3]Repeatable Story Missions[/h3]
         [list]
         [*]Upon completing the game, you can keep your party and go through the missions again with ramped up difficulty! 
         [/list]
       [*] [h3]Mysterious Dungeon Reworked[/h3]
         [list]
         [*]Post-game missions have returned but have been overhauled.
         [/list]
       [*] [h3]Significantly Improved Loading / Startup time[/h3]

  [/list]

[*][h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
   [list]
      [*] [h3]I was able to achieve my goals for the rework of the game:[/h3] 
      [list]
         [*] Develop more classic RPG-style story and gameplay
         [*] Have more variety between the different missions. 
         [*] Provide moments where a character can grow strong over the course of a battle and do powerful things.
         [*] Add a mini-game to play between missions
      [/list]
   [/list]

[*][h2]Other Notes[/h2]
   [list] 
         [*] All Scores are Reset
         [*] Congratulations to [i]SilverPrime[/i] for completely breaking Roguelite Mode! But, rage abilities no longer increase the rage of the caster.
         [*] Epic Mode [i]and[/i] Survival Mode are affected this update. Survival Mode keeps the mechanic where you select bonuses and treasures every few days. Epic Mode now requires you complete battles to unlock these bonuses/treasures. 
         [*] Roguelite Mode has only been affected by bug-fixes and the addition of Pickups 
   [/list]

notes.title: Goals for 2023. Story Mode Revamped
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Despite the less frequent content updates, significant progress is being made on the new and completely redone Story Mode
[list]
[*] There will be less of a focus on generic missions and more of a focus on a linear set of story-mode battles.
[list]
[*] Currently, there doesn't feel like there is an objective to train or get stronger. I want the player try the next mission, fail, take on a generic mission or two, and then succeed.
[/list]
[*] There will a greater focus on variety.  I want each mission to feel different.  I will achieve this a few different ways:
[*][list]
[*] Enemy or Allied bosses with unique abilities: ones that target all enemies, that target multiple areas, or do other powerful things.
[*] There will be more variety in objectives.  Defending certain characters, reaching destinations, surviving.  
[*] In-battle bonuses. Some missions allow your character to gain stats and heal by taking out certain enemies. Additionally, pickups have been added: some missions will allow you to walk over a pickup and immediately gain a bonus, cast a spell, or summon a unit.
[*] Having interesting allied units
[/list]
[*] There will be less units on the screen at once. Battles will be closer to 6v6 than 7v7 or 8v8.
[list]
[*] Oftentimes the battles seem too cluttered
[*] I want many missions to have AI-controlled allies, but the battles felt like there were too many units on-screen already
[/list]
[*] Reinforcements
[list]
[*] Many missions will have fewer enemies on screen, but enemies will enter battle over time. The same can occur for allied players
[list]
[*] It is simply more fun for the player's 6 allies to destroy 20 enemies than it is to destroy 6 more powerful enemies
[/list]
[*] Similarly, bosses will have more HP but have less enemies on screen at once (the rest will trickle in)
[list]
[*] This allows the user to experience the boss more throughout the battle without having him be too powerful or too vulnerable.
[/list]
[*] There will be battles where you selected, say, 7 characters, but only 4 will ever be on-screen at once. The rest will enter the battlefield whenever you lose an ally.
[/list]
[*] The Party-Upgrades will only be granted to you in Survival Mode. Epic mode will require the player to unlock the bonuses through completing certain missions (which will be available at any time in its own mission list).
[*] Other features may be added to the game before I have a chance to finish this story-mode
[list]
[*] A time travel ability, that rewinds the game, inserts an action, then fast-forwards the game. 
[*] Limit-Break-like set of abilities for the protagonist, certain enemies, or certain classes.
[*] New Tier 2 or Tier 3 classes. I have many ideas.
[*] More job-upgrades
[/list] 
[*] Lastly, I will be continuing to eliminate bugs, improve AI, optimize loading times.  All of which have had drastic improvements over the last year.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Split game into two Game-Modes!
notes.content:
[b]The game is split into 2 Game Modes[/b]:  Epic and Survival.  The missions will barely scale in Epic Mode and there are no lives.  People who enjoy grinding and getting good gear would prefer this mode.  End-game content coming soon.

Survival mode has the difficulty rising very fast and have limited lives.  EXP and gold are accumulated about 3 times faster.  Players who enjoy a challenge and do not like grinding will prefer this mode.  This mode determines high scores.

Existing files default to Epic Mode.
